acquisition_method: The variable window data in-dependent acquisition (DIA) method is described by Bruderer et al.
alkylation_concentration: alkylated with 25 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 30 min
alkylation_reagent: alkylated with 25 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 30 min
cleavage_agent: Proteins were digested by incubation with trypsin (1/100, w/w, Sequencing Grade Modified Trypsin, Porcine; Promega) for at least 9 h at 37 °C.
collision_energy: with a stepped normalized collision energy (NCE) of 25.5, 27 and 30.
fractionation_method: fractionated with High pH Reversed-Phase (Pierce) into a total of 96 samples.
fragmentation_method: with a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 27.
instrument: Peptide analyses (corresponding to 1 μg protein) were performed on a Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) connected to an EASY-nLC 1200 ultra-HPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: inferred: No isobaric or metabolic labeling agents were mentioned in the sample preparation or analysis sections; quantification was performed using precursor intensities and TRIC alignment.
mass_analyzer: inferred: The instrument model Q Exactive HF-X uses an Orbitrap mass analyzer, as implied by the text describing resolution settings typical for Orbitrap instruments (e.g., resolution of 120,000).
reduction_concentration: reduced with 5 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride, pH 7.0, for 45 min at 37 °C
reduction_reagent: reduced with 5 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride, pH 7.0, for 45 min at 37 °C
